To find the characteristic polynomial of the matrix $A = \begin{pmatrix} 3 & -12 & 13 \\ -6 & 13 & 11 \\ -7 & -6 & -8 \end{pmatrix}$, we compute the determinant of $(A - \lambda I)$:
$$p(\lambda) = \det \begin{pmatrix} 3 - \lambda & -12 & 13 \\ -6 & 13 - \lambda & 11 \\ -7 & -6 & -8 - \lambda \end{pmatrix}$$

Expanding this determinant along the first row gives:
$$p(\lambda) = (3 - \lambda) \left[ (13 - \lambda)(-8 - \lambda) - (11)(-6) \right] - (-12) \left[ (-6)(-8 - \lambda) - (11)(-7) \right] + 13 \left[ (-6)(-6) - (13 - \lambda)(-7) \right]$$

Let's simplify each part:
1. For the first term:
$$(3 - \lambda) [ \lambda^2 - 5\lambda + 38 ] = -\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 53\lambda + 114$$

2. For the second term:
$$12 [ 125 + 6\lambda ] = 72\lambda + 1500$$

3. For the third term:
$$13 [ 7\lambda + 127 ] = 91\lambda + 1651$$

Adding them all together:
$$p(\lambda) = (-\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 53\lambda + 114) + (72\lambda + 1500) + (91\lambda + 1651)$$
$$p(\lambda) = -\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 + (-53 + 72 + 91)\lambda + (114 + 1500 + 1651)$$
$$p(\lambda) = -\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 + 110\lambda + 3265$$
